name: Home · Beginner
description: Nerd Fitness beginner workout. One dumbbell and a stable support. Warm up first; complete 2 circuits on non-consecutive days. Rows: 10 per arm; walking jacks: 10 per side. One plank entry means a 15–30 second hold. Set your dumbbell weight in the editor. The 12 sessions organize the Trace log; they are not an original program duration.

exerciseNotes.Knee plank · 15–30 seconds: Hold for 15–30 seconds. 1 logged rep = one hold.

name: Home · Strength
description: Recommended Routine adaptation. Pull-up bar, equipment for rows and dips, a band for Pallof presses, and a stable support for reverse hyperextensions. Train 3 times per week on non-consecutive days. Warm up for 5–10 minutes. Alternate each of the first three exercise pairs for 3 rounds, then do 3 core rounds. Rest about 90 seconds between paired sets and 60 seconds in the core block. Select appropriate variations: begin at 3×5, reach 3×8, then choose a harder variation. Core: 3×8–12. Update progression manually in the editor. Unilateral reps are per side. Starting leg and core variations are selected here; alternatives are in the source. Twelve sessions organize four weeks of logging.
